claim_check.claim_reason: The core meaning of 'non compliant as per the usage' (meaning according to usage standards or rules) is distorted to 'incompatible by usage share'. 'Usage share' typically refers to the proportion or prevalence of something being used, fundamentally altering the criterion for non-compliance/incompatibility.

chart_check.reason: Perfect semantic match for all text elements. 'Compliant' is accurately translated as 'Compatible', and 'compliance' as 'Compatibility', without any loss of meaning or nuance.

claim: More than 50 % of the acid 2 test were found to be non compliant as per the usage.
